title: Mind in Zazen
speaker: Shinmon Michael Newton
summary: The talk highlights that Zen is not about transcending words, but rather finding nourishment in them when they resonate with our hearts and souls. This idea is illustrated through stories of Zen ancestors who turned away from book learning to focus on meditation, and how this approach can help us connect with the present moment. By embracing emptiness and openness, we can express wisdom and compassion for all beings, and find freshness and simplicity in each moment.
